chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Indeed, preceding the Reappearance of the Qa'im, there will be a year of abundant rain in which the dates on the palm trees will rot, so do not doubt that.
ai.seo_question: What are the signs of the year preceding the reappearance of Imam Mahdi?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) identifies the 'year of Ghaydaqah' as a distinct climatic sign preceding the Reappearance, where excessive rain causes dates to spoil on the palm trees. This phenomenon is interpreted by Shia scholars as both a literal environmental marker and a metaphor for economic stagnation or a lack of market demand, reflecting the divine preparation of the world for the Mahdi’s justice.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 450 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Hasan bin Mahbub from Ali bin Abi Hamza from Abu Basir from Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) that he said:
“The year preceding the reappearance of Imam Qaim (a.s) will be so verdant that dates will rot on the trees and there will be no one to pick them. Have no doubt about it.”
